segments.source: Two men, a white man and a negro, had a discussion.
The white man said : “ I, in my house there is lacking nothing, I have all (things).”
In thy house, I look for a thing, I do not find it.”
The white man said: “You, negroes, you lack all things ; I have to look for nothing.”
Manii, o muku’a uatambula umbanda ua hoji a hitu.
O muku’a, uatambula o umbanda, uxi: “Ngiia kua kamba diami, uakuatele pata.”
